sections.Profile:
The Apollo 13 pinball machine, released by Sega in 1995, is renowned for its innovative 13-ball multiball mode, the largest ever in pinball history. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and Joe Balcer, the game captures the excitement of the Apollo 13 mission with a variety of interactive features.

- Manufacturer: Sega Pinball Inc. (US)
- Years made: 1995
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 6
- Tags: Disaster, Licensed, Space, 1990s, Solid State
